d:
The pressure is on at Orange County Choppers as Paul Sr., Paul Jr. and the OCC crew race to complete the Sikorsky Helibike. From precision rivet work and turbine-inspired exhaust pipes to custom rotor-style wheels, this custom motorcycle build demands serious fabrication skills and attention to detail. With the reveal deadline approaching, tensions rise between Senior and Junior over speed, design and the finishing touches.
Watch American Chopper Season 4 Episode 106, “Sikorsky Helibike,” only on discovery+ India.
